title: Odile and the Horizon
author: Astrid Dunmore
blurb: Ansel Vasquez, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the concession permits expire.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
